meta.label: Artificial population
meta.description: Simulated planets around nearby stars from the Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars with Bergsten+2022 occurrence rates — the setup of Schlecker et al. (2024). 0.5–5 M⊕, transit depth ≥ 80 ppm.

meta.label: PLATO targets (P4 + P5)
meta.description: Simulated planets around real PLATO Input Catalogue stars: P4 M dwarfs and P5 FGK dwarfs combined. Optimistic detection scenario: 5-yr mission, transit depth ≥ 60 ppm, 0.5–20 M⊕.
